data.body_html:
Planning a marbella sunset cruise proposal is the most romantic way to ask the big question. Picture this: you’re on a private yacht, the golden sun sinks behind La Concha mountain, cava glasses clink, and the only sound is the gentle Mediterranean lapping against the hull. At Boat Rental Marbella, we make that moment effortless. Our fleet of 14 private boats departs from Puerto Banús, each with a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT included – no hidden extras. Whether you want an intimate 2-hour charter for two or a lavish 4-hour affair with friends, we’ve got the perfect vessel.

Why Choose a Sunset Cruise for Your Proposal?

A sunset cruise offers privacy, natural beauty, and a built-in romantic atmosphere. The Costa del Sol’s west-facing coastline means you’ll watch the sun dip into the sea from the best seats on the water. Marbella’s average sea temperature in summer is 24°C, and the breeze keeps it comfortable even on hot evenings. You’re not competing with crowded beach restaurants or noisy bars – it’s just you, your partner, and the sky turning pink over the Golden Mile.

Our Best Boats for a Romantic Proposal

For a two-person proposal, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are ideal. Both cost €749 for 2 hours and come with a professional skipper who’ll stay discreet. If you want to invite a few friends or family to celebrate afterwards, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) at €4,719 for 4 hours includes a free jet ski – perfect for a post-ring adrenaline rush. For a truly grand gesture, the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) or Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) offer deck space for a photographer and a champagne toast in style. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

What’s Included in Your Sunset Charter

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire charter
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (olives, nuts, crisps, fruit)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no surprises

We can also arrange flowers, a photographer, or a custom playlist – just let us know via WhatsApp when you book.

Best Sunset Spots Near Marbella

From Puerto Banús, your skipper will head west towards the Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés – secluded coves with stunning sunset views. Alternatively, cruise past the Río Verde estuary or anchor off Cabopino for a clear horizon. If you want a longer trip, head towards Estepona (about 30 minutes from Banús) where the coast opens up for an uninterrupted sunset. The skipper knows all the quiet anchorages where you won’t be disturbed.

How to Plan the Timing

Sunset in Marbella ranges from 18:00 in December to 21:30 in June. We recommend a 2-hour charter starting 30 minutes before sunset. That gives you time to settle in, enjoy the golden hour, and have the sun dip exactly at the halfway point – perfect timing for the question. We’ll confirm the exact departure time when you book, based on the date.

Proposal Extras (Optional)

  • Flowers (bouquet or single rose) – from €40
  • Professional photographer (30 min on water) – €150
  • Custom playlist via Bluetooth – free
  • Champagne upgrade (Moët or Veuve) – €80 per bottle
  • Cake or chocolates – from €30

All extras must be requested at least 48 hours before departure. We’ll coordinate with the skipper so everything is ready when you step aboard.
